items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I took in -- I'm trying to remember who I took in on that job. Well, there's a guy named Tiny, Big Tiny Mitchell, who was a guitar player.

ctx.x: So whom did you take in with you?

I took in -- I'm trying to remember who I took in on that job. Well, there's a guy named Tiny, Big Tiny Mitchell, who was a guitar player. A great big guy. My God, he was such a huge man. He was a very fine guitar player. And I think I had another guy named Herschel Coleman, who was -- Herschel? Yes, Herschel Coleman, was a trumpet player, he was a very fine trumpet player.
